description:
We are seeking a dedicated SDC/Infection Control Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. In this vital dual role, you will be instrumental in both staff development and maintaining rigorous infection prevention standards, ensuring the highest quality of care for our residents.

This position offers a unique opportunity to shape staff competency through comprehensive education programs while safeguarding the health and well-being of our community by leading infection control initiatives. We offer a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42 for this impactful role.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license
Experience in staff development and education
Experience in infection prevention and control practices
Knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
Strong communication and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42, based on experience.

description:
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Marketing Director to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Sarasota County, FL. This is a unique opportunity to lead marketing efforts for a recently acquired facility, driving census growth and community engagement. We are looking for a proactive and results-driven individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment.

The ideal candidate will be highly presentable, possess exceptional interpersonal skills, and demonstrate a 'hustler' mentality to achieve marketing objectives. This role requires working occasional weekends to support events and outreach initiatives. We offer competitive compensation for the right professional who can make a significant impact.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, preferably within a skilled nursing or healthcare facility.
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute effective marketing and admissions strategies.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a professional and presentable demeanor.
Proactive and results-driven approach to market development and census growth.
Ability to work occasional weekends as needed for community events and outreach.

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated PRN Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Inverness, FL. This critical role offers an excellent opportunity to provide essential speech and language therapy services to patients, contributing significantly to their rehabilitation and quality of life. We are looking for a compassionate professional ready to make an immediate impact.

This position comes with a highly competitive hourly rate ranging from $38 to $49, reflecting the critical nature of the role. To further support your transition, a generous $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus is available. This PRN opportunity provides flexibility while allowing you to be an integral part of a supportive healthcare team.
requirements: Master's degree in Speech-Language Pathology
Current state licensure as a Speech Language Pathologist in Florida
Certificate of Clinical Competence in Speech-Language Pathology (CCC-SLP)
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team
salaryOrBonusInfo: This critical PRN role offers a competitive hourly rate of $38 - $49, along with a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus.

description: Are you a dedicated Physical Therapist Assistant looking for a flexible PRN opportunity? A premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL, is seeking a compassionate and skilled PTA to join their therapy team. This role offers the chance to make a significant impact on patients' recovery journeys, providing essential support and care. As a PRN Physical Therapist Assistant, you will work collaboratively with licensed Physical Therapists to implement individualized treatment plans, helping patients regain mobility, reduce pain, and improve their overall quality of life. This is an excellent opportunity for a professional seeking flexibility while contributing to a supportive and patient-focused environment.
requirements: Current and valid Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) license in the state of Florida.
Associate's degree from an accredited Physical Therapist Assistant program.
Current CPR certification.
Prior experience in a rehabilitation or skilled nursing facility is preferred.
Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly compensation for this PRN role ranges from $28.00 to $37.00, based on experience and qualifications.
